options.content: The 2026-10-12 dev scrape of /metrics did not include queue depth, oldest queued-job age, or a worker heartbeat. Do not graph those as zero. Upload completion counts are in the admin activity API, not in this Prometheus scrape.

panels.title: Sidecar failures
panels.description: Unit: failures/second. Population: memwal_sidecar_failures_total. A missing series means the metric was not registered, not that uploads succeeded.
